note: Progress is calculated from implementation tasks: done counts fully, in progress counts halfway, and to do counts zero. Expand a task for steps and acceptance criteria.

categories.name: Core engine
categories.summary: Shared systems that all game content runs on.

taskTemplate.name: Define the runtime contract
steps: Trace every caller and lifecycle hook related to {feature}; record the authoritative entry and exit points in code comments only where non-obvious.
Define valid inputs, owned state, observable outputs and cleanup responsibilities for {feature}.
Reuse the existing engine service or manager pattern nearest to {feature}; do not add a parallel abstraction.
acceptanceCriteria: All existing callers route through one authoritative implementation.
Invalid state is rejected without corrupting world or player state.

taskTemplate.name: Implement lifecycle integration
steps: Connect {feature} to startup, tick, login/logout or shutdown hooks only where its state actually changes.
Make repeated initialization and cleanup idempotent.
Ensure exceptions cannot leave registrations, timers or world entities orphaned.
acceptanceCriteria: Starting and stopping the server twice produces the same registered state.
Interrupted operations clean up owned resources.

taskTemplate.name: Persist and restore state
steps: Identify which {feature} state must survive logout or restart and add it to the existing persistence format.
Validate and default missing or stale saved values during hydration.
Restore state before dependent packets or plugins consume it.
acceptanceCriteria: Old saves without the new fields still load.
A save/load round trip preserves all player-visible {feature} state.

taskTemplate.name: Handle concurrency and edge cases
steps: List the tick-order, disconnect, duplicate-request and capacity edge cases for {feature}.
Add guards at the shared mutation boundary rather than at individual callers.
Make failures observable with an actionable error or player message.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate or reordered requests cannot duplicate state or items.
Disconnecting mid-operation leaves the world consistent.

taskTemplate.name: Add automated engine coverage
steps: Locate the smallest existing test or smoke-check pattern used by neighbouring {feature} code.
Add a deterministic happy-path check for {feature} that fails before the implementation and passes afterward.
Add one failure or boundary case covering the highest-risk state transition for {feature}.
acceptanceCriteria: The check runs through an existing repository test command without network access.
A regression in the implemented {feature} behaviour produces a clear failing assertion.

categories.name: Minigames

taskDetails.name: Complete lobby, entry and team assignment
steps: Verify all Saradomin, Zamorak and Guthix portal coordinates and options against the active cache.
Remove test-only automatic bot seeding from production flow or gate it behind explicit development configuration.
Enforce team-size balancing, forbidden head/cape equipment and external consumable restrictions before teleporting.
Cover leaving, logout and countdown cancellation from both waiting rooms.
acceptanceCriteria: A player cannot join an invalid or overfull team.
A lobby can return to idle with no bots, colours, overlay or countdown task left behind.

taskDetails.name: Complete the match lifecycle and HUD
steps: Keep idle, starting, active and ending transitions in one authoritative state machine.
Verify the 20-minute timer, minimum-player rules, early termination and two consecutive matches.
Drive both team HUDs from server score, flag and timer state without stale cached vars.
Restore login/logout participants to the lobby with temporary state removed.
acceptanceCriteria: A match starts and ends exactly once under normal, empty-team and disconnect paths.
A second match begins with zero score, safe flags and no previous timers or entities.

taskDetails.name: Complete flag capture, return and scoring
steps: Verify stand pickup, weapon-slot requirements, carrier hints and stand object replacement for both teams.
Handle carrier death, manual drop, stepping-stone return, teammate return and enemy pickup.
Require the scoring team's own flag at base before capture and update HUD state on the same tick.
Prevent repeated stand/object interactions from duplicating flags or scores.
acceptanceCriteria: Every flag state has exactly one representation: stand, carrier or dropped object.
A deterministic capture scenario increments one score and restores the captured flag.

taskDetails.name: Implement every arena interaction and supply
steps: Audit every gate, door, barrier, stair, ladder, tunnel and stepping-stone route in both castles and underground.
Implement barricade placement limits, ownership, attack/destruction, clipping cleanup and explosive-potion interaction.
Implement rocks, rope, pickaxe, tinderbox and toolkit uses plus table take-1/take-5 limits.
Verify spawn-room restrictions, altar use and enemy spawn blocking.
acceptanceCriteria: Every visible arena option is handled or deliberately documented as unsupported.
Ending the match removes all temporary NPCs, clipping, items and dynamic objects.

taskDetails.name: Add Castle Wars end-to-end regression coverage
steps: Build the smallest plugin smoke harness with two players and deterministic task ticks.
Cover join, countdown, start, flag steal/drop/return/capture, death/respawn, score HUD and rewards.
Add failure checks for friendly fire, enemy bandaging, teleporting, team-colour removal and reconnect.
Assert win, loss and tie ticket amounts plus complete cleanup after endGame.
acceptanceCriteria: The test fails when any core flag or cleanup invariant regresses.
The scenario runs locally without network, real-time waits or manually spawned clients.

taskTemplate.name: Implement entry, lobby and team rules
steps: Map every {feature} entrance, exit and lobby object to the existing area/plugin hooks.

acceptanceCriteria: Invalid entrants remain outside with a useful message.

taskTemplate.name: Implement the match state machine
steps: Define explicit idle, starting, active and ending states for {feature}.
Implement minimum-player checks, countdown cancellation, timed transitions and clean restart.
Keep timers and scheduled tasks owned by one match instance and cancel them on reset.
acceptanceCriteria: A match starts and ends once under normal and cancellation paths.
Two consecutive matches do not inherit scores, objects or timers.

taskTemplate.name: Implement objectives, scoring and rewards

acceptanceCriteria: Scores visible to clients match authoritative server state.
Reconnect, death or repeated interaction cannot duplicate score or rewards.

taskTemplate.name: Implement arena mechanics and cleanup

Ending or aborting a match restores every participant and world object.
